description: Scaffolder working at 8m height dropped a 5kg scaffolding wrench which fell past workers on lower deck. Scaffolder was also unhooked.
Electrician accessed 440V motor control center without lockout tagout or voltage detector test.
Two workers entered nitrogen purged crude storage tank without air testing equipment or SCBA.
High pressure flange loosened while line was still pressurized at 40 bar resulting in hot steam escape.
